laws.statement: Candidate universe and bound-source union are independently derived before procedure execution.
Every semantic operand is a declared typed argument; every RESOLVE_ONE names the explicit verification_universe.
Finite closed JSON AST only; no callbacks, recursion, IO, mutation, or identifier dispatch.
All array-backed maps are unique; discovered reference owners equal declared owner universe; references resolve once.
Ordered assertions emit first failure code and deterministic witness; codes are statically authorized.
Exact caller-supplied expected package identity triple plus a separate caller-supplied acceptance profile; neither comes from the candidate payload.

Verified frozen and accepted-source bytes are supplied in the separate acceptance profile; metacontract pins, candidate source copies, and builder constants are claims only and must compare whole-object before semantic use.
